name: HTML Tag and Class Replace
author: Jahid Hasan

sections.description:
HTML Tag and Class Replace is a lightweight and user-friendly WordPress plugin designed to let you easily replace HTML tags and classes across your website. Whether you’re optimizing for SEO, improving design consistency, or customizing your theme, this plugin simplifies the process with just a few clicks.

Features:

  • Effortlessly replace any HTML tag for better semantic structure and SEO optimization.
  • Modify or replace HTML classes to enhance your website’s styling and consistency.
  • Perfect for bloggers, developers, and website owners aiming for more control over their site’s HTML output.

Injection Locations:

  1. Header Section
  2. Body Section
  3. Footer Section

Why Choose HTML Tag and Class Replace?

It’s a quick and powerful solution that helps you make critical HTML updates without diving deep into your website’s codebase.

Notes

HTML Tag and Class Replace is the easy way to replace your website tag and class in your WordPress header, body and footer.
sections.installation:
1. Install HTML Tag and Class Replace by uploading the html-tag-and-class-replace directory to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate HTML Tag and Class Replace through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. The page will redirect you to the settings Page.
  4. You can change this option any time you want by going to the Settings > Tag and Class Replace menu.
sections.faq:
Can I use HTML Tag and Class Replace for Solveing SEO issue?

Yes.

Can I use HTML Tag and Class Replace for replace Div Class name ?

Yes.
